title: ScootRadar — Scooter feeds
description: The scooter feed cache's Prometheus metrics: which feeds the map serves, how often they are collected, the origin API and the process. See docs/OBSERVABILITY.md.

list.name: Deploys
list.textFormat: A deploy or restart; counters start again

panels.title: Feeds served
panels.description: Feeds whose positions the map shows, including those whose last collection failed.

panels.title: Usual feeds stopped
panels.description: Expired now, though served more than half of the last 7 days: what the 'ScootRadar feed stopped' alert reports.

targets.expr: count((max by (feed, source, provider) (scootradar_feed_state{job="scootradar-cache", state="expired"}) == 1) and on (feed) (avg_over_time((max by (feed) (scootradar_feed_state{job="scootradar-cache", state=~"ok|failing"}))[7d:5m]) > 0.5)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Failing, still served
panels.description: The last collection failed; the previous positions are served until they are 15 minutes old.

panels.title: Snapshot age
panels.description: Since a collection last finished. Swiss feeds are collected every minute and the others at staggered times, so this stays at a few seconds.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Resident memory. The container is limited to 2048 MiB, of which Node gives the V8 heap 1072 MiB.

panels.title: Feeds by state
panels.description: ok: served. failing: the last collection failed, the previous positions are still served. expired: nothing is served and the map says the provider is not sharing data.

panels.title: Usual feeds stopped
panels.description: Expired now, though served more than half of the last 7 days, with the age of the last positions held. The 'ScootRadar feed stopped' alert fires after 10 minutes here.

targets.expr: (time() - max by (feed, source, provider) (scootradar_feed_observation_timestamp_seconds{job="scootradar-cache", source=~"$source"})) and on (feed) (max by (feed, source, provider) (scootradar_feed_state{job="scootradar-cache", state="expired"}) == 1) and on (feed) (avg_over_time((max by (feed) (scootradar_feed_state{job="scootradar-cache", state=~"ok|failing"}))[7d:5m]) > 0.5)

panels.title: Expired, rarely served
panels.description: Expired now and served less than half of the last 7 days: dead feeds, and feeds such as Velospot that publish fresh data only now and then. Silence isn't success, but these do not alert; their snapshot_feed_failed lines in Loki say why.

targets.expr: (max by (feed, source, provider) (scootradar_feed_state{job="scootradar-cache", state="expired"}) == 1) unless on (feed) (avg_over_time((max by (feed) (scootradar_feed_state{job="scootradar-cache", state=~"ok|failing"}))[7d:5m]) > 0.5)

panels.title: Oldest positions held
panels.description: The ten feeds with the oldest positions held. The map shows positions up to 15 minutes old (the red line): a feed nobody looks at may pass it, and is collected again as soon as someone does. Swiss Voi publishes about every 8 minutes, 90 seconds late.

panels.title: Collection failures per minute by provider
panels.description: Includes the dead feeds: every minute while always-fast or watched, otherwise backing off to every 10 minutes.

targets.expr: sum by (provider) (rate(scootradar_feed_collection_duration_seconds_sum{job="scootradar-cache", source=~"$source"}[15m])) / sum by (provider) (rate(scootradar_feed_collection_duration_seconds_count{job="scootradar-cache", source=~"$source"}[15m]))

panels.title: Parking on time (regional feeds)
panels.description: The map shows parking availability up to 5 minutes old. A feed collected every minute is on time within 5 minutes; an idle one within its interval and ten minutes, as it is collected again when someone looks. The app maps (Dott, Voi, Lime, Qick and the others read from an operator's app) collect no parking and are left out.

panels.title: Catalog age
panels.description: Discovery runs hourly and city totals are rebuilt hourly; city totals are rejected after 3 hours.

panels.title: Feeds by cadence
panels.description: always: collected every minute (SCOOTER_ALWAYS_FAST, Switzerland by default). watched: someone looked in the last 10 minutes, every minute. idle: every 20 minutes.

panels.title: Collections started per minute by reason
panels.description: always and watched: every minute. wake: a request found the data over a minute old. idle: every 20 minutes. retry: an idle feed that failed, after 1, 2, 4, 8 then 10 minutes.

panels.title: Requests to operators per minute
panels.description: What the cache sends to the operators' feeds. status: positions and parking availability; metadata: documents kept an hour or more.

panels.title: Requests that waited for a collection per hour
panels.description: A request for positions too old to show waits up to 3 seconds for their collection. timeout: it answered without them and asked to be polled again.

panels.title: Scooters with a price, by provider
panels.description: The share of the scooters served that carry a price. Bird and PubliBike publish none. A drop for one provider: its scooters name plans the cache has not loaded, which it fetches again within minutes (pricing plan refreshes, beside), or plans the app cannot show.

panels.title: Pricing plans fetched again per hour
panels.description: A feed's pricing plans fetched again because a scooter named a plan they did not list, as Lime's do when its rate changes. listed: the plan is there now; unlisted: still missing, or the fetch failed, so it is looked for again after 2, 4, 8… minutes.

panels.title: Requests per minute by status
panels.description: Requests from the Worker. 503: still warming up, or every feed covering the area has expired. 429: a visitor over 60 requests a minute.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: The container is limited to one core.
